intro.body: This page allows you to backtest Decision API behavior against /r/ruby's last 1000 posts and comments.
steps: Look at each item the model flagged, mark your own decision re if it should be flagged or not
Adjust the threshold to see what % of flagged comments match your assessments
You can also try new wordings of rules and rerun the backtest
